title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 30, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.3 (Peaked October 30, 2026 at 13:22 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 332 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Things are buzzing a bit in near-Earth space! 🛰💡🌎

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
